correctness.rationale: Free amalgamation realizes exactly the avoiding assignments to old-pair indicators; each old triple yields a negative three-coordinate clause. Matched overlapping clause pairs have exact joint satisfaction 1-2p^3+p^5 and single clauses 1-p^3. Harris applied to blocks proves the inequality. Conditioning on a shared essential bit gives strictly positive covariance between distinct overlapping blocks, proving the complete equality condition. Disjoint four-vertex two-edge blocks and disjoint three-vertex one-edge blocks realize each (m,nu). Direct checker exhaustively tests n=3,4,5 at 3 rational biases, and 35 n=6 samples; unlimited n follows from the proof, not these finite tests.

value.rationale: The one-point type spectrum of the generic tetrahedron-free hypergraph has a natural but nonindependent family of clauses. The matching number measures disjoint sources of dependence, gives a multiplicative strictly-positive correction and a sharp iff structural equality classification valid across all finite bases and all bias parameters. Matching-block families multiply the correction exponentially, while long shared-pair pencils demonstrate large, persistent information differences compared with the independent-clause heuristic. The result identifies precisely when that common counting heuristic is exact rather than presenting an arbitrary small table gain.
